title: Noragami's Adachitoka Launches New Manga
content:
The October issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Magazine announced on Friday manga duo Adachitoka will launch a new manga titled Yadoya no Oinu-sama (The Inn's Dog) in the next issue on October 6.

Adachitoka posted a preview image of the manga on their X/Twitter account on Friday.

The story follows middle schooler Kasumi Kuromine, a girl who resides in the countryside. One day, on a school field trip, an accident happens and she falls down the mountainside.

Adachitoka launched the Noragami: Stray God manga in Monthly Shonen Magazine in 2010, and ended the series in January 2024. Kodansha shipped the 27th and final volume in February 2024.

The manga inspired a 12-episode television anime series that premiered in January 2014. Funimation streamed the series as it aired and released it on home video. The anime's second season, titled Noragami Aragoto , debuted in October 2015, and Funimation also streamed that series as it aired and released it on home video. The series also inspired two stage plays: the first in January 2016, and the second in February 2017.

Kodansha released the first volume of Noragami: Stray Stories in Japan in November 2013. BONES adapted one of the stories from the manga as an original anime DVD that shipped with the 15th volume of the manga in Japan.
author: ANN

title: 'Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru 3rd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, New Staff, Second Promo
content:
• The official website for Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru 3rd Season ( As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World Season 3 ) television anime revealed additional cast, new staff, a second key visual (pictured), and the second promotional video Friday.

The anime series adapting Miraijin A 's adventure fantasy light novel began airing on September 27 on CBC and TBS' 28-station "Agaru Anime" programming block at 11:30 p.m., with the first episode airing at 12:00 a.m.

Voice actors Sumire Morohoshi ( Yakusoku no Neverland ) and Hinata Tadokoro ( Ousama Ranking ) are joining the cast as Musha Trick and Zatt Brozd, respectively.

(※Muri ja Nakatta!?) animation director) NEW Color Design: Miho Tanaka ( Ikoku Nikki ) Art Director: Ryouko Hashizume ( SSSS.Gridman background art) (Creep) NEW Director of Photography: Yasuji Yamagoe ( Mahoutsukai no Yakusoku ) Editing: Hitoshi Nogawa ( Triage X ) Music: Kujira Yumemi ( Lv2 kara Cheat datta Motoyuusha Kouho no Mattari Isekai Life ) Sound Director: Toshiki Kameyama ( Otome Game no Hametsu Flag shika Nai Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei shiteshimatta... ) Studio: GeyeG Pictures NEW

Note: The staff denoted with the legend NEW are new in their respective roles .

Voice actress Rico Sasaki ( BanG Dream! Ave Mujica ) is performing the opening theme "Still Water" and rock band akuruyo-sheep performs the ending theme "Hibi wo Koete." Both songs are previewed in the promotional video below.

Miraijin A began penning the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in October 2019. Kodansha published the first volume with illustrations by JIMMY under its K Ranobe Books imprint in July 2020. The ninth volume went on sale on June 2.

Natsumi Inoue began drawing a manga adaptation on the Magazine pocket app in June 2020. Kodansha published the 21st volume on June 9.

Kodansha USA licensed both the manga and light novel in English in November 2021 and March 2022, respectively. The 14th manga volume went on sale on April 21. The seventh light novel volume was published on November 18.

title: 'Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo, Theme Songs
content:
The official website of the Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru ( I'm Dating a Dark Summoner ) television anime revealed two additional cast, the theme songs, a second key visual (pictured), and a second promotional video on Friday. The short anime series adapting Shaoh 's comedy fantasy manga will premiere on October 5 at 1:20 a.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS11 on October 8.

Voice actresses Akane Nishimura and Maya Yashika are joining the cast as Haru Parvain and Eury Lililala, respectively.

Ringo Coisio is performing the opening theme "Zettai Kansei♡Kisei Jijitsu." Mao Komiya is performing the ending theme "AKUMA♰No?☆Hime♡Goto."

Seiya Miyajima ( Umayon ) is directing the short anime at AtoriE , as well as handling the series composition and script. Takahiro Sasaki ( Kitaku-bu Katsudou Kiroku ) is designing the characters and serving as the chief animation director.

Shoah began serializing the manga in Dra-Dra Sharp# website in November 2021. Kadokawa published the seventh volume on March 9, with the eighth volume scheduled for release on October 9.

title: The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in a Different World as an Aristocrat Season 2's Video Reveals More Cast, January Debut
content:
Kadokawa streamed the first main promotional video and first key visual for the second television anime season based on Rui Tsukiyo and Reia 's The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in a Different World as an Aristocrat ( Sekai Saikō no Ansatsusha, Isekai Kizoku ni Tensei Suru ) light novel series on Friday. The video announces more cast members, and also announces the anime's January premiere.

The new cast members include:

Sumire Uesaka as Epona Rhiannon, the hero and eldest son of the Rhiannon baronial house

Yūsuke Tonozaki as Neusche Gephis, a student at the Royal Knight Academy who is already an S-class student upon entry

The anime's returning cast members are:

• Kenji Akabane as Lugh

• Reina Ueda as Dia

• Yūki Takada as Tart

• Shino Shimoji as Maha

Masafumi Tamura ( Wise Man's Grandchild , The Misfit of Demon King Academy , Two Car ) returns to direct the second season at SILVER LINK. , Katsuhiko Takayama ( Two Car , Ange Vierge , The Future Diary ) is again in charge of overseeing the series scripts, Eri Nagata ( Ensemble Stars! , Blade & Soul ) is again designing the characters, and Kenichi Kuroda is again composing the music at Lantis .

The anime's first season premiered in October 2021.

Yen Press is releasing the novels in English, and it describes the story:

When a great assassin is reborn in another world, he finds himself the heir to a long line of killers from the shadows. With both his modern-day knowledge and experience and the special magic and techniques of this new world, he could very well become the most unstoppable assassin in history…!

Tsukiyo began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in July 2018. Kadokawa began publishing the story in print volumes with illustrations by Reia in February 2019.

Hamao Sumeragi launched a manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Young Ace Up manga website in January 2019. Yen Press is also releasing the manga in English.

title: 'Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha, Isekai Kizoku ni Tensei suru Season 2' Reveals Additional Cast, New Staff, First Promo for Winter 2027
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Rui Tsukiyo 's Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha, Isekai Kizoku ni Tensei suru ( The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat ) light novel revealed additional cast, new staff, a key visual (pictured), and the first promotional video for the second season on Friday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027.

Voice actresses Sumire Uesaka ( Tokidoki Bosotto Russia-go de Dereru Tonari no Alya-san ) and Yuusuke Tonozaki ( Baki-dou ) are joining the cast as Epona Rhiannon and Naoise Gephis, respectively.

Staff Director: Masafumi Tamura ( Maou Gakuin no Futekigousha ) Script, Series Composition: Katsuhiko Takayama ( Ore wa Seikan Kokka no Akutoku Ryoushu! ) Character Design: Eri Osada ( Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu. ) Chief Animation Director: Minao Ootsuki ( Deep Insanity: The Lost Child assistant chief animation director) NEW , Haraguchi Wataru ( Ragna Crimson chief animation director) NEW Sub Design: LoopEnd NEW Prop Design: LoopEnd NEW Art Director, Background Art: Hiroya Yoshiyama ( Tearmoon Teikoku Monogatari background art) (SIEstA) Color Design: Hayato Yoshida ( Fuguushoku "Kanteishi" ga Jitsu wa Saikyou Datta ) Director of Photography: Masaki Kubomura ( Megaton-kyuu Musashi 2nd Season ) (Tripod) NEW 3D Director: Eda Keiichi ( Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai o Suberu ) (Chiptune) Editing: Misato Takikawa ( Tamon-kun Ima Docchi!? ) (Real-T) NEW Sound Director: Masaki Tsuchiya ( Isekai Mokushiroku Mynoghra ) Sound Effects: Kiyotaka Kawada ( Kenja no Deshi wo Nanoru Kenja ) NEW Sound Production: Glovision Music: Kenichi Kuroda ( Seijo no Maryoku wa Bannou desu ) Music Production: Lantis Studio: Silver Link.

Note: The staff denoted with the legend NEW are new in their respective roles .

The first anime season co-produced by Silver Link., Studio Palette aired in 12 episodes in Fall 2021. Crunchyroll streamed the anime with subtitles and subsequently with an English dub.

Tsukiyo began writing the action fantasy series on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in July 2018. Kadokawa began publishing the novel through its Sneaker Bunko imprint featuring illustrations by Reia in February 2019 and shipped the eighth volume in August 2024.

A manga adaptation by Hamao Sumeragi has been serialized on the Young Ace UP web magazine since January 2019. Kadokawa released the ninth volume on February 10.

Yen Press licensed both the light novel and manga adaptation in English in July and August 2020. The eighth light novel and manga volumes shipped on February 10 and February 24, respectively.

title: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner Anime's Video Reveals More Cast, Theme Songs, October 4 TV Debut
content:
The official website for the short anime of Shaoh 's I'm Dating a Dark Summoner ( Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru ) manga unveiled the main promotional video and visual for the anime on Friday. The video announces more cast members and the anime's October 4 television premiere, and also announces and previews the anime's opening theme song "Zettai Kansei♡Kisei Jijitsu" by Ringo Coisio . The site also announced that Mao Komiya is performing the ending theme song "AKUMA♰No?☆Hime♡Goto."

The newly announced cast members are:

Akane Nishimura as Haru, the party leader and swordswoman

Maya Ayahane as Eury, an elf archer that hails from the Lilylala forest

The anime will premiere on the Tokyo MX channel on October 4 at 25:20 (effectively, October 5 at 1:20 a.m.), and on BS11 on October 7.

The fantasy manga's story begins when Amona, a demi-human dark summoner who uses the power of demons, joins the party of the righteous cleric Roni. Everyone thought that they would be at each other's throats within a minute, but by the end of Amona's first day in the party, they share a passionate night together.

The main cast members are:

• Rei Takano as Amona

• Yūki Nishiyama as Roni

• Hōden Tei Senmai as Imp

Seiya Miyajima ( Umayon , BanG Dream! Girls Band Party! Pico ) is directing as well as overseeing and writing the series scripts. Takahiro Sasaki ( Chronicles of the Going Home Club ) is the character designer and chief animation director. Other staff members include:

• Sound Director: Fumihiko Ōtera

• Art Director: Yōichirō Yamamoto

• Color Design: Daiki Ura (DEFA)

• Director of Photography: Tasuku Ozu

• Editing: Toma Hayashima

• Producer: Yasuhiro Aoki, Kōta Hashiguchi

• Animation Studio: AtoriE

• Animation Assistance: Nyan Pollution-ω-

WWWave Corporation 's Deregula anime label is producing the anime. WWWave Corporation owns the ComicFesta web manga service, as well as the AnimeFesta anime programming block.

HIDIVE will stream the anime.

Shaoh launched the manga in Kadokawa 's Dra Dra Sharp# online manga magazine in 2021. Kadokawa published the manga's seventh compiled book volume on March 9, and will publish the eighth volume on October 9.

title: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Part 2's Video Unveils Theme Songs, October 11 Debut
content:
The staff for the anime of Hitsuji Gondaira 's Mission: Yozakura Family ( Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen ) manga unveiled a new promotional video and visual for the second part of the anime's second season on Friday. The video announces and previews the second part's theme songs, including the opening theme song "Forever Song" by the rock band Humbreaders , and the ending theme song "I'm still breathing" by the dance and vocal group KID PHENOMENON . The video also announces the second part's October 11 premiere date.

The second part of the second season will premiere on MBS , TBS , and 26 other channels on October 11 at 5:00 p.m. (4:00 a.m. EDT).

Disney describes the anime's story:

High school student Taiyou Asano has been socially inept ever since his family died in a car crash. The only person he can properly interact with is his childhood friend, Mutsumi Yozakura—the head of the world's strongest family of spies. Mutsumi's eldest brother, Kyouichirou Yozakura, has been overprotective of her ever since he once rendered her severely injured. His love for Mutsumi is lethal, and Taiyou is his next target. To survive, Taiyou must marry Mutsumi and become a member of the Yozakura family. Thrown headfirst into chaos, Taiyou begins his journey to become a powerful spy in order to protect his wife and uncover the dark secrets of his past and the Yozakura family.

For the current season, Mirai Minato is now the chief director of the anime at SILVER LINK , and is again overseeing the series scripts. Takahiro Nakatsugawa , who worked as a storyboard artist and episode director on the first season, is directing the anime. Other returning staff includes character designer Mizuki Takahashi , composer Kōji Fujimoto , and sound director Tōru Kanegae .

The second season premiered on April 12 on MBS , TBS , and 26 other affiliated channels during the "Nichigo" programming block, which runs on Sundays at 5:00 p.m. JST (4:00 a.m. EDT). Hulu streams the new season. The second season's first part ended with the anime's overall 39th episode on June 28.

The first season premiered in Japan in April 2024 on MBS , TBS , and 26 of their affiliate channels. Disney streams the anime through the Hulu service with an English dub in the United States. The series also streams on Prime Video and Netflix in Japan.

Gondaira ( Demon Prince Poro's Diaries ) launched the manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in August 2019. The manga ended its serialization in January 2025. Shueisha published the 29th and final compiled book volume in March 2025.

Viz Media simultaneously published the manga in English digitally since its debut in Japan. Viz Media then began publishing volumes digitally in December 2020, and began releasing the series physically starting with the first volume in October 2022. Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service also released the manga digitally in English.

The franchise also includes several novels.
author: ANN

Viz Media then began publishing volumes digitally in December 2020, and began releasing the series physically starting with the first volume in October 2022. Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service also released the manga digitally in English.
The franchise also includes several novels.

title: Tanuki to Kitsune Anime's Video Unveils Cast
content:
Frontier Works unveiled a new promotional video for the television anime based on Atamoto 's Tanuki to Kitsune (Raccoon Dog and Fox) manga on Friday. The video reveals the first footage from the anime and also the voice cast:

The cast members include:

• Misaki Kuno as Tanuki

• Nao Tōyama as Kitsune

• Toshiyuki Morikawa as Ōkami

• Maria Naganawa as Usagi and Narrator

• Takuma Nagatsuka as Kuma and Usagi

The manga's story centers on the daily lives of a raccoon dog who is not quite with it and a mischievous fox who likes to tease the raccoon dog. The two are close friends who live together on a mountain. Their other friends include a wolf, a bear, a rabbit, and birds.

Tommy Hino ( Kumarba (TV 3) , Crane Game Girls ) is directing the anime at Akatsuki Media Studio , and Rika Kihara ( Sylvanian Families Freya no Piece of Secret ) is writing the scripts.

The anime will premiere on October 4. The anime will air within the "Animori" program that airs on TV Tokyo and its affiliates on Sundays at 7:00 a.m.

The anime celebrates the franchise 's 10th anniversary.

Atamoto began serializing the manga on X (formerly Twitter ), and Frontier Works releases the manga in print. The series has already inspired a wide variety of merchandise, as well as stamps on the LINE messaging and social media app.

The franchise contains manga's 10 volumes and three picture book volumes. The second volume of a new manga series titled Tanuki to Kitsune Yurutto will ship on October 15. The overall book franchise has 1.35 million copies in circulation.

A previous series of web anime shorts debuted in February 2018.

title: Live-Action Look Back Film's Clip Highlights Kyōmoto, Fujino Creating Manga
content:
The official website for the live-action film of Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot manga presented a new clip from the film on Friday. The clip shows Kyōmoto and Fujino creating a manga together.

The Cannes International Film Festival describes the film:

Spanning more than a decade, Hirokazu Kore-eda 's tender coming-of-age story follows two girls who bond over their passion for and dream of becoming manga artists. Fujino, a gifted artist and aspiring manga artist, meets Kymoto, a shy admirer of her work. Seemingly opposites, they create the perfect team with their shared love of the form. But as their work draws praise and attention, they find themselves confronted with decisions that threaten their artistic collaboration. Koreeda's beautiful love letter to friendship and the creative process offers keen insight into the craft.

Aju Makita ( Child of Kamiari Month , Happiness ) plays Kyōmoto, while Natsuki Deguchi ( I Have a S/e/c/r/e/t/, Blue Spring Ride ) plays Fujino in the film.

Hirokazu Kore-eda ( Shoplifters , Our Little Sister , Air Doll ) is directing and editing the film, and is also writing the screenplay. Yūta Bandō ( BELLE , Kaiju No. 8 , also known as Taku Matsushiba ) is composing the music.

The staff also includes:

• Photography: Senzo Ueno

• Lighting: Masachio Nishida

• Sound: Kazuhiko Tomita

• Art Direction: Shinsuke Kojima

• Costume Design: Sachiko Ito

• Hair and Makeup Supervision: Katsuhiko Yūmi

• Assistant Director: Kensei Nakayama

• Scripter: Ryōko Taguchi

• Casting: Toshie Tabata, Yōko Yamashita

• VFX Supervisor: Rinto Ueda

• Line Producer: Shinichi Muraoka

Musician Kenshi Yonezu , actress and singer Tōko Miura , and animator and director Yōko Kuno will have special guest staff roles in the film. Yonezu will perform guitar for the film, credited under the "Shark Kick Guitar" moniker, while Miura will perform vocals for an insert song in the film. Kuno will direct a rotoscoped animation sequence based on their performance, with Shinei Animation producing the animation.

The film will open on September 11 in Japan. GKIDS will release the film in theaters in 2026 in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., and Ireland. The 79th Cannes International Film Festival showcased the film on May 15. The London Film Festival will screen the film in October.

Fujimoto debuted the one-shot manga on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ in July 2021. The manga had over 2.5 million views on its first day. Viz Media and MANGA Plus launched the manga digitally in English. Viz Media published the manga in print in September 2022.

The anime film adaptation of Fujimoto's " Look Back " one-shot manga opened in theaters in Japan in June 2024. It ranked at #2 in terms of ticket sales (but #1 in weekend earnings) in its opening weekend. The film sold 135,000 tickets and earned 227 million (about US$1.40 million) in its first three days.

GKIDS screened the anime film in October 2024 in North America. The film earned US$688,253 at the U.S. box office in its opening weekend.

Fujimoto ( Fire Punch ) debuted the Chainsaw Man manga in Weekly Shonen Jump in December 2018 and ended its "first part," the "Kōan" (Public Safety) arc, in December 2020. The manga's second part, titled "Gakkō-hen" (School Arc), started on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ service in July 2022, and it ended on March 24 (March 25 in Japan).

title: Konami's Project Zircon Deckbuilding Roguelike Game Streams New Teaser
content:
Konami presented a new teaser trailer for its Project Zircon deckbuilding roguelike game during its Konami Press Start livestream on Thursday. The trailer previews gameplay footage for the game, but does not announce a release date. The game now has a Steam page , confirming a planned release for PC.

The game's Steam page describes the game:

PROJECT ZIRCON is a deckbuilding roguelike card game. As the ruler of a nation, recruit powerful Character Cards and construct Facilities to expand and strengthen your nation. Build a new strategy every run to save the world from the resurrected Calamity Dragon of the Abyss.

Konami first revealed Project Zircon as a cross-media web3 project in September 2023. The project has since expanded to other mediums, including tabletop games, murder mystery games, novels, and manga. Konami announced a planned video game for the project in September 2025.
